title: Synth instrument document
description: One instrument for the sculptor synth, written for humans and LLMs. Units are musical: times in seconds, LFO rates in Hz, pitches in semitones, amounts 0..1. Paste into a zone with the zone right-click menu's 'Paste from Clipboard'. Copy an existing zone with 'Copy to Clipboard' to see a real document. A document is rejected whole (nothing changes) when a field is unknown or out of range, or when a required field is missing. Omitted optional fields have working defaults; nested objects must provide their own required fields. The bank's channel and master effect chains and free-standing parameters are outside this format on purpose: a document covers the instrument only.

format.description: Required document type and version identifier. The v1 decoder refuses any other value.

note_skew_semitones.description: Random pitch skew drawn once per note.

layer_skew_semitones.description: Random pitch skew drawn per oscillator layer.

graph_layout.description: Optional portable positions and sizes of nodes derived from this instrument; no effects, wiring or missing-sum state; optional custom parameter names.  Canonical 0 is input, 1 is sum, 2+n is oscillator layer n, which must exist.  Generator locators use layer and fixed numeric ModTarget; descriptor aliases resolve after the whole document parses and may have only one saved record.  Parameter ordinals are zero-based extant derived target groups, not descriptor IDs.  Unresolved or duplicate resolved nodes are refused.  All numbers must be finite; sizes are nonnegative.  Newly encoded documents always include this array.

name.description: Custom parameter title; must fit 31 UTF-8 bytes and cannot contain NUL.

layers.description: Oscillator layers mixed together in one instrument voice. The editor supports up to 7; each Add Oscillator action adds one layer.

wave.description: Waveform names. A sawtooth at duty 0.5 is a triangle; a pulse at duty 0.5 is a square; set the target block 'duty_a' or 'duty_b' to place the duty.

mod_target.description: Modulated quantities. Units: volume, panning (0.5 = center), duty_a/duty_b, osc_mix and fm_index (1.0 = full depth) are 0..1; pitch is -24..24 semitones; the cutoffs are 20..20000 Hz, with 0 meaning the filter is bypassed. Only 'volume' defaults to 1.0 and 'panning' to 0.5; every other base defaults to 0.

mod_source.description: MIDI modulation sources. velocity is per-note; aftertouch is polyphonic; pressure_combine is the max of per-note aftertouch and channel pressure.

source_op.description: How a value combines onto its target: added or multiplied.

layer.description: One oscillator. The shared routing (base, sources) may be set by the first layer that supplies base or sources for a target (a layer with only generators does not claim it); every layer has its own envelope and LFO generators.

wave_a.description: Required. The primary oscillator; for fm the carrier, for sync the master.

wave_b.description: The second oscillator; for fm the modulator, for sync the slave. Default: none.

mode.description: blend mixes both waves by osc_mix; fm frequency-modulates wave_a with wave_b; sync hard-syncs wave_b to wave_a.

mod_ratio.description: The FM ratio (fm) or hard-sync cycle ratio (sync); 0 is a legal bank value, any nonzero value is 0.125..8; ignored by blend.

pitch_offset_semitones.description: This oscillator's pitch offset in semitones.

target_block.description: One modulated quantity: a shared base value plus MIDI sources, with this layer's envelope and LFO generators on top.

base.description: The value in the target's units (see mod_target). Defaults: volume 1.0, panning 0.5, everything else 0.

sources.description: MIDI inputs combined onto the base value.

scale.description: How much of the source applies; negative inverts.

envelope.description: The envelope this layer plays into the target. Point levels are the envelope's output values in the target's units, so a volume envelope sweeps 0..1 and a pitch envelope sweeps semitones.

time_seconds.description: When the point is reached. Points quantize to ~5.8 ms ticks; a leading run of time 0 is allowed (the unplaced-point layout) and every later point must land on a later tick. The maximum is ~380 s.

level.description: The value reached, in the target's units. Generator levels are free finite values - the editor's envelope min/max slots are unbounded - so unlike the base they are not restricted to the slider range. Levels quantize to 16-bit steps; a cutoff level 0 keeps the filter bypassed at that point.

sustain_start.description: First point of the sustain loop; defaults to the last point (hold the end value until release).

sustain_end.description: Last point of the sustain loop; must not precede sustain_start; defaults to the last point.

wave.description: Required. The pool only holds sine and sawtooth LFOs; place the duty with this LFO's own 'duty' field.

frequency_hz.description: Required. Cycles per second; the period must land between 1 ms and 65.535 s.

min_level.description: The LFO's low output, in the target's units; free finite values, not restricted to the base's slider range. Defaults to the target's minimum.

max_level.description: The LFO's high output, in the target's units; free finite values, not restricted to the base's slider range. Defaults to the target's maximum.

op.description: How the LFO combines onto the target.

depth.description: How much of the LFO applies; negative inverts.

depth_source.description: A MIDI source scaling the depth.

rate_source.description: A MIDI source scaling the rate.

rate_scale_ms.description: Milliseconds of period the rate source adds per unit.
